finalText:
The build was failing because `resolveRelease` merged config layers with a shallow `Object.assign`, so any package that only overrode one key inside `output` or `sourcemap` (like `@acme/api` setting just `output.format`) lost the rest of that nested object, including `output.dir` — which `build.js` then rejected as incomplete.

I replaced the shallow merge in `packages/shared/config.js` with a recursive `deepMerge` that merges nested plain objects key by key instead of replacing them wholesale, while still letting later layers (package overrides, then CLI flags) win on any individual key.

Both `node build.js` and `node verify.js` now finish clean, and verify also confirms defaults aren't mutated and CLI-level partial overrides layer correctly.
